translation.name: GOD ETER AGERKE NAMDERASEM TUMA YENBO

book.name: APOSEL
book.title: APOSEL Aposel tame eme kerebetem yaku.

content: Pol ere Romri Keryen Sisar eterke yin ere eri tuma mette wom.
Festus ere Sisaria komke yam, yabel mur yim, ere Sisaria kom mesginin Jerusalemke yawom.
Yawom, Juda etemri keryen, God eteri ake eisauri apeilake eme Pol eterken ei nakwosem tuma eme yin Festus erne wusowum. Eme erne tuma yenbo wom.
Eme erne etep wom. Ne Pol erne won Jerusalemke yate. Etep wom, etemri porerek eme keluke berasen kowun Pol erne pen sate abom.
Festus ere tuma awosein etep wom. Pol ere Sisariari ake yaperke tetan. Yuri an Sisariak sene yite.
Keremri apeilake tame eme arenken Sisariak yite. Pol ere kap wule yaper wuri nenem, eke kem erne tuma etek namdete. Etep wom.

Festus ere yabel ep yekwo let ep yekwo let bor mur keyem (8-pela), o yabel ep yekwo let ep yekwo let ere etemken ten ere Sisariak sene yim. Yim, kwokwos ere tuma namdebe akek yin sin ere etep wom. Kem Pol erne panen ya.
Yamke, Jerusalemke yam Juda tame nogwape eme Pol erne tetyewon ouyeyin erne tuma nogwape eisau erne namdem. Emri namdem tuma e somoken berai. Eme erne bepou me wom.

Pol ere emne tuma awosein etep wom. An wule yaper beke wuri nen. Juda etemri wule an yaper beke wuri nen, God eteri ake eisauri wule an yaper beke wuri nen, Romri apeilake tame eisau eri wule an yaper beke wuri nen. Etep wom.
Festus ere Juda tatame emne noub nente abom, ere Pol erne etep wom. Ne mapeke abobe? Ne Jerusalemke yite, an neri tuma etek mette.
Pol ere etep wom. Berai. An beke kip yi. Gwote ake, aren tetan ake, e Romri tuma namdebe ake. An Rom tame, eme ane gwote akek tuma namdete, e yenbo. Ne metten, an Juda emne ei tuma beke wuri wo.

An wule wuri tousite, eme ane ek pen sate, e yenbo. An tumaken berai. Eme ane wobe tuma, an etemri tuma namde akek beke kip yi. An abobe, an Romri apeilake eisau eterne yin late. Eter ere ari tuma mette.
Etep wom, Festus ere eteri porereken tame etemken namden ere Pol erne awosein etep wom. Romri apeilake eisau eter ere neri tuma mette, ne etep woye, an eterne nene won yin tuma namdete.
Agripa ere Pol eri tuma metem.
Yabel kau yim, apeilake tame Agripa ere geisiken, geisi teri sig Bernaisi, epe Sisariak yin Festus erne sipkom yin erne pir won pap yewote wom.
Yim, yabel nogwape etek temenemke, Festus ere Agripa erne Pol eteri tuma erne wusowun etep wom. Feliks ere tame wuri erne ake yaperke won yim, ere etek som tetan.

Kiyi an Jerusalemke yin temenem, God eteri ake eisauri apeilake tameken Juda etemri apeilakeken eme ane yan lan etep wom. Pol ere wule yaperke nenem. Ne erne noub sin meten, erne pen sate. Eme ane etep wom.
An emne awosein etep wom. Romri tame nema paku emne bepou beke pe. Tame ere eterken tuma namdebe tame etemri bitimik teten ere emne tuma awosein wote, e yenbo. An emne etep wom.
Yuri eme arenken gwotek yam, an som beke kou. Kwokwos an tuma namdebe akek yin sin an emne etep wom. Kem Pol erne panen yate.
Yam, tuma namdebe tame eme yan teten eme erne tuma namdem. An kiyi abom. Eme eri nenem wule yaper wusoute. Eme etep beke wusou.
Eme etemri sukye worabe wule, kiyi sam tame eteri tumake namdem. Sam tame eri sig Jisas. Pol ere etep wom. Ete tame ere sam, ere wou sene peten ere kelpe tetan.
Tuma somo mette kelu an soplawoyim. Etepkap, an Pol erne wom. Ne Jerusalemke yite, an neri tuma etek sene mette.

Pol ere mo won etep wom. An mo woye. An ake yaperke temente. Romri apeilake tame eisau ere ari tuma mette. Etep ten an erne lakerebetem tame emne etep wom. Kem Pol erne noub lakerebet. Yuri an erne won Romri apeilake tame eisau eterne yin late.
Etep wom, Agripa ere Festus erne etep wom. An ete tame eri tuma mette aboye. Festus ere awosein etep wom. Kipik neken ek mette. Etep wom.

Kwokwos Agripa eteri geisi Bernaisiken epe kerap yenbo wolen tuma namdebe akek wurim. Ei nai tame nogwape apeilakeken komri apeilake eme kir etepken wurin sim. Wurim, Festus ere won eme Pol erne panen woram.
Festus ere etep wom. Apeilake, kem akei ete tame erne late. Juda tatame nogwape Jerusalemri o gwoteri erne tuma noub neremri bitimik eme namdem. Eme ane noubke etep wom, eme erne pen sate wom.

An lam, ete tame ere be wule yaper beke wuri nen. Eme erne mane pen sate. Ete tame ere etep wom. An Romri apeilake tame eisau eterne yin late, ere ari tuma mette. Etep womke, an akeite wos beke kip nen, an erne won Romri apeilake tame eisau eterke yite.

An siglou bas rasen Romri keryen erne tuma somo bas raste. Be tuma an bas raste? An tuma somo an noub beke met. An ete tame erne gwotek yate woye, apeilake tame Agripa, neren ne eri tuma noub meten ane wusoute. Wusoutek, an tuma somo kir siglouke bas raste.
Ake yaperke tetan tame an erne bepou won yite, e yaper. Namdebe tuma kir siglouke bas rasen newopitte, e yenbo.
